edition.notes: The five syllables namah śivāya are pan-Śaiva (Yajurvedic Śatarudrīya contains namah śivāya). ॐ is the praṇava prefixed in japa. Cross-checked standard recitations; no variant in the five akṣaras.

description.hi: शिव का पञ्चाक्षर — न म शि वा य। जप का मूल नाम।
description.en: Shiva's five-syllable mantra — na ma śi vā ya — the root Name for japa.
